newsFlag.summary: Kyle Juszczyk did not practice Tuesday due to an ongoing finger injury, though he practiced Monday and the absence may be veteran management.
Undisclosed
Personal
Mike Evans is dealing with a groin/adductor injury and will miss practice this week, with hopes to return next week before the season opener on September 10 in Australia.
Darren Waller is being eased into his first season with the Panthers after recently signing and is sitting out preseason games as a precautionary measure, not due to injury.
Mariota returned to practice Monday after missing two weeks with a sprained MCL in his right knee suffered on Aug. 14, and is increasing his workload in preparation for the 2026 season.
Undisclosed
McCaffrey participated fully in practice drills and is trending positively toward Week 1 availability after returning to practice over a week ago.

Kittle is recovering from an Achilles tendon tear and is trending toward playing in Week 1 against the Rams, but a final decision won't be made until the team arrives in Australia, with potential snap limitations if cleared.

Deshaun Watson was named the Browns' starting quarterback after winning a preseason job battle, though he has a history of significant injuries including a torn Achilles tendon and re-rupture that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
James Conner has been placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to ongoing foot injury complications, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Mitchell Trubisky is dealing with a biceps injury and missed Wednesday's practice, but the injury is considered minor and he remains day-to-day.
Patrick Mahomes is on track to start Week 1 against the Broncos after recovering from a torn left ACL sustained last December.
Alvin Kamara sustained an MCL sprain and is expected to be out for at least one month, putting his Week 1 availability in jeopardy and making him a candidate to open the season on injured reserve.
McNichols was placed on injured reserve with a quadriceps injury and won't be eligible to return until at least Week 5 of the 2026 season.
Ray-Ray McCloud was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season.
Christian Kirk was placed on injured reserve with a calf injury and must miss at least four games to start the regular season.
Lamar Jackson is fully healthy heading into the 2026 season after hamstring and back injuries limited him in 2025.
Moore suffered an ankle injury in a preseason game but has returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1 of the regular season.
Calvin Ridley appears healthy after playing in a preseason game following a broken fibula last season, though his role is limited as the No. 3 receiver.
Meyers is returning to practice Wednesday after a hand injury sustained two weeks ago and is expected to play in Week 1 against the Browns.
Justice Hill is healthy heading into the 2026 season after an injury-shortened 2025 but remains in a backup role behind Derrick Henry.
D.J. Montgomery was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to an abdominal injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season.
Singletary is not in uniform for Friday's preseason game against the Jets, but this appears to be a rest decision rather than an injury.
Undisclosed
David Sills was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and is ineligible to return until Week 5.
Ty Johnson remains sidelined with a lower leg injury but has resumed running and sprinting, with limited fantasy relevance due to his role as a reserve running back behind James Cook and Ray Davis.
Undisclosed
Metcalf dealt with an undisclosed injury during training camp but returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Falcons.
Achilles
Josh Jacobs was placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List due to domestic violence charges and is ineligible to practice or play until the legal matter is resolved.

Dobbins was cleared to return to practice after a soft-tissue injury and is expected to be the Broncos' top running back this season, though his availability for the preseason finale remains uncertain.
Pittman missed practice time and preseason action due to a hamstring injury but is expected to be ready for Week 1 and has returned to practice.
AJ Dillon is active and played in the preseason game, but could see increased role if other Panthers RBs (Hubbard, Etienne) suffer lingering injuries heading into Week 1.
Jeudy will not play in the Browns' preseason game against the Bills, though he played in the previous preseason opener without apparent injury.
Tee Higgins is dealing with a heel contusion heading into Week 1, but coach Zac Taylor expects him to be available for the season opener against Tampa Bay.
Chuba Hubbard returned to practice Tuesday while recovering from a mid-August hamstring injury and is trending positively toward season readiness.
Hamstring
Jermar Jefferson was reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve Monday with an undisclosed injury and will spend the entire 2026 regular season on IR.
Brock Wright is healthy and active, with potential opportunity to start Week 1 if Sam LaPorta's hip injury prevents him from playing.

Ben Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's preseason game and entered the NFL's five-step concussion protocol, requiring clearance from an independent neurologist before potentially playing in Week 1.
Ja'Marr Chase sustained a left knee hyperextension injury during practice but is expected to return as a limited participant this week and should be ready for the Week 1 opener against Tampa Bay.
DeVonta Smith is a full participant in practice after returning in limited capacity the previous week, continuing his recovery from a hamstring injury.
Trevor Lawrence will not play in Friday's preseason game against the Panthers, sitting out for rest purposes during the exhibition schedule.
Travis Etienne is healthy and positioned to see increased offensive touches and snaps early in the season due to teammate Alvin Kamara's MCL sprain expected to sideline him for at least a month.
Trey Sermon was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons for an undisclosed injury and is ineligible to play in 2026 unless waived with an injury settlement.
Knee
Cole Turner was placed on the Dolphins' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach a settlement to have any chance of playing in 2026.
Grant Calcaterra was placed on injured reserve with a back injury and designated to return, sidelined until at least Week 5.
Melton is active and healthy but faces roster uncertainty due to poor preseason performance and competition for his special teams role.
Irvin Charles was placed on injured reserve by the Seahawks with an undisclosed injury suffered during preseason and is ineligible to return until Week 5.
Isiah Pacheco has been placed on injured reserve with a back injury and MCL sprain, with no clear timetable for return and expected to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Cameron Dicker is working through an undisclosed issue and was not at full capacity in the preseason finale, leaving his Week 1 availability uncertain despite coach Harbaugh's stated confidence.
Rachaad White is sidelined with a hamstring injury sustained Aug. 19 and will miss the Commanders' final two preseason games, though he is making progress with individual drills.

Khalil Shakir has been sidelined since August 20 with an undisclosed injury and missed the Bills' final two preseason games, leaving less than two weeks to recover before the regular season opener on September 13.
Tyler Allgeier is expected to be active and could serve as the Cardinals' primary running back if Jeremiah Love's high-ankle sprain limits his availability to start the season.
Ty Chandler suffered a season-ending knee injury in a preseason game and was placed on injured reserve, missing the entire 2026 season.
Chris Oladokun was placed on the Chiefs' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will miss the 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Skylar Thompson has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Brittain Brown was placed on injured reserve by the Bears due to an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Groin
Metchie is active and participating in preseason games, though he has a history of injury issues and is competing for a roster spot on the Panthers.
Alec Pierce is recovering from offseason ankle surgery and missed most of training camp and all preseason action, but the Colts hope he will play in Week 1 against the Ravens.
Calvin Austin III suffered a torn ACL and was placed on injured reserve, ruling him out for the entire 2026 season.
Robinson took a hard hit during joint practice with the Bears but passed concussion tests, with early indications promising for Week 1 availability.
Breece Hall is recovering from a minor groin strain and participating in limited agility drills, with focus on returning for Week 1 rather than the preseason game.
Cade Otton returned to practice after missing about a week with an undisclosed injury, though his availability for the preseason finale remains uncertain.
Kenneth Walker III is dealing with ankle swelling but is expected to be fine with no extended absence anticipated.
Will Mallory was placed on injured reserve with a thumb injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 regular season, with the earliest return possibility being Week 5.
Mitchell is missing his fourth consecutive practice due to an undisclosed injury but is working with trainers on the side, and the Chargers GM expects him to play in Week 1.
Kendre Miller sustained a minor injury at practice but avoided a serious setback and has a chance to be available.
Bigsby is returning to full practice participation after missing Monday's session due to a toe injury that appears to be maintenance-related rather than serious.
Undisclosed
Scott Matlock was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the 2026 regular season, with the earliest possible return in Week 5.
Willis participated in Tuesday's practice while in the concussion protocol following a preseason injury, and must be cleared by an independent neurologist before becoming available.
Tyrell Shavers was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a torn ACL suffered in the wild-card round and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season.
Knee
Princeton Fant has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Jake Bobo sustained a serious knee injury during a joint practice with the Titans and was placed on injured reserve, ruling him out for the entire 2026 season.
Nate Adkins participated in Broncos training camp practice Monday after leaving Friday's session with a trainer, suggesting the injury was minor.
Emanuel Wilson has been designated as Questionable and his availability status for the upcoming game is uncertain.
Ben Sims was placed on the Dolphins' injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least four games, with a possible injury settlement allowing him to join another team once healthy.
Marvin Mims Jr. suffered a bruised foot in the preseason finale and missed practice Monday, but has two weeks to recover before the regular season opener.
Tank Dell is on injured reserve with a knee injury and must miss at least the first four games, though the GM indicated he is progressing toward a return.
Addison played in the preseason opener despite a thumb jam from early training camp and caught his only target for eight yards.
Tucker Kraft is expected to be 'full go' for Week 1 after recovering from a torn ACL sustained 10 months prior, though he is being rested in the preseason finale as a precaution.
Josh Downs participated in Tuesday's practice after missing some time with a minor calf injury and is expected to be off the injury report for Week 1.
Achane is inactive for a preseason game against the Giants, likely a rest/maintenance decision rather than an injury concern.
Zay Flowers is recovering from a left quadriceps bruise sustained on Aug. 8 and is expected to return to full practice next week, remaining available for the Ravens' Sept. 13 season opener.
LaPorta returned to practice Tuesday after suffering a hip injury, trending positively with over two weeks remaining before the regular-season opener.
Rice returned to game action for the first time since a December concussion and appears healthy heading into Week 1, though he has a recent history of knee and concussion issues.
Davis Allen is recovering from a quadriceps injury and was limited in practice, but is expected to be available for the regular season opener after missing the preseason finale.
Puka Nacua (groin) is ramping up gradually at practice ahead of Week 1, working off to the side during team drills after missing significant time in training camp.

Luke Musgrave (neck) was placed on the PUP list and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 season with an uncertain return timeline after failing to practice during training camp and preseason.
Reed is being rested for Friday's preseason game in Denver as a precautionary measure after briefly missing practice time earlier in the month, but remains healthy and available.
Zach Charbonnet suffered an ACL tear in his left knee on January 17 and will miss at least the first four games of the season.
Johnny Wilson was placed on injured reserve by Philadelphia due to a knee injury and will miss the entire upcoming season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Chris Collier was placed on injured reserve by the Raiders for the 2026 season with an undisclosed injury and is unlikely to play unless an injury settlement is reached.
Undisclosed
Malik Nabers (knee) missed the open portion of Tuesday's practice but participated later in the session, though his Week 1 availability remains uncertain.
Xavier Legette sustained an ankle injury during Wednesday's joint practice and will remain in a walking boot until Thursday, expected to miss Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.
Brooks missed practice Tuesday due to general soreness but is expected to be available as part of a running back committee with Chuba Hubbard.
Isaac Guerendo was placed on the reserve/PUP list due to a pectoral injury and will miss at least the first four weeks of the season.
Groin
Jamari Thrash has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Tracy suffered a neck stinger in the preseason finale and is practicing in a non-contact jersey, making his availability status uncertain.
Hamstring
Carter Bradley suffered a thumb injury during preseason and has been placed on injured reserve, likely to miss the entire 2026 season.
British Brooks returned to practice after a three-week absence following hand surgery in early August and is working to be ready for Friday's preseason finale.

Mason Tipton was placed on the reserve/PUP list after undergoing tibia surgery in the offseason and is expected to miss at least the first four games of the regular season, with potential return in Week 5.
Cole Burgess has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Jeshaun Jones received a three-game suspension for violating the NFL's substance-abuse policy and will be ineligible for game action until Week 4.
Tip Reiman was moved to the reserve/PUP list due to an ankle injury and must miss at least four games before becoming eligible to return.

Braelon Allen started at RB in place of the injured Breece Hall and is currently the team's top available running back, though Hall is expected back by Week 1 and Isaiah Davis could compete for backup duties once healthy.

Isaiah Davis (knee) participated in side field work with a trainer during Tuesday's practice after missing the first two preseason games, with his availability for Friday's exhibition against the Giants still uncertain.
MarShawn Lloyd is now the top available option in the Packers backfield with Josh Jacobs sidelined, presenting an opportunity but with limited playing time so far this season.
Erick All passed his conditioning test and is cleared to participate in training camp following multiple knee surgeries for an ACL injury that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
Theo Johnson is participating in non-contact practice after a shoulder injury sustained last Monday but appears on track to play Week 1 against the Cowboys.
McMillan missed most of training camp with a knee injury and remained sidelined at Tuesday's practice, though there is optimism about his availability for Week 1 against the Bengals.
Keon Coleman sustained a right foot/toe sprain in the preseason opener but has progressed to practicing and removing his walking boot, with nearly two weeks to recover before Week 1.
Undisclosed
Jayden Daniels returned from a four-game absence due to an elbow injury and played limited snaps in preseason, with his performance expected to improve as he ramps up.
Ben Sinnott is dealing with an oblique injury, will miss the preseason finale, and needs to return to full practice over the next two weeks to be ready for the season opener.
Knee - PCL
Penix is recovering from a torn ACL and will miss Friday's preseason game but expects to be available for Week 1 against the Steelers.
Trey Benson reverted to injured reserve due to ongoing knee troubles from a meniscus injury suffered in Week 4, with difficulty staying on the practice field despite returning from surgery.
J.J. McCarthy remains on the Vikings' 53-man roster with an ankle injury while serving as a backup quarterback behind Kyler Murray.
Thomas Yassmin was reverted to injured reserve by the Packers and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Savion Williams is on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain and is expected to return in Week 5 for his 2026 debut on October 11.
Tyler Loop is expected to handle Week 1 kicking duties for Baltimore despite recent missed field goals and competition from practice squad addition Jake Moody, putting his job security at risk.
Jimmy Holiday was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.

Ashton Jeanty remains sidelined with a low-ankle sprain suffered Aug. 23 and needs to practice next week to have a chance to play in Week 1 against the Dolphins, though the GM indicated he is in a 'good spot' with recovery.
Tyler Warren (adductor strain) participated in Tuesday's practice and is expected to have no restrictions for Week 1 against the Ravens.
Egbuka is dealing with a toe injury but was able to work with trainers and run without obvious issues, with expectations he'll be nearing full health by Week 1.
Jayden Higgins was placed on injured reserve after suffering a torn ACL in practice and will miss the entire 2026 season.
Hamstring
Ayomanor exited Thursday's practice early with a left shoulder issue but is practicing Friday and appears to have avoided a serious injury.

Jordan James returned from a rib fracture to play in the preseason and showed promise as a runner and receiver, though his role behind other backs and limited preseason action leaves some uncertainty about his regular season usage.

Ollie Gordon II suffered a minor rib injury in preseason but would have been cleared to play in a regular-season game, with his participation this week determining if he plays in the preseason finale.
Devin Neal was placed on injured reserve due to a hamstring injury sustained in preseason and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Will Howard suffered a concussion during preseason and is in the NFL's five-step concussion protocol, requiring evaluation by an independent neurologist before returning to full contact practice.
Kalel Mullings is listed as Questionable on the injury report.
Knee - ACL
Kyle Monangai sustained a right knee hyperextension on Aug. 16 and is week-to-week, putting his availability for the season opener on Sept. 13 at risk.

LeQuint Allen Jr. is a game-time decision for Week 1 against the Browns with an undisclosed injury, and coach Liam Coen suggested he'd be "pleasantly surprised" if Allen plays, indicating the running back is unlikely to be available.
Caleb Lohner was placed on injured reserve with a lower-body injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 regular season, with the earliest possible return in Week 5.

Croskey-Merritt missed the final two preseason games due to a lower-body injury and is expected to return to practice next week, with his participation level to be determined before the regular-season opener.
Moliki Matavao was placed on injured reserve due to a knee injury sustained during preseason and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Jacoby Jones was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Commanders.

Ja'Quinden Jackson was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury after being waived by Philadelphia and not claimed by another team, despite negative CT scans from an ambulance transport incident during a preseason game.
Coleman Owen was placed on injured reserve due to a concussion suffered during the preseason finale and will miss the entire season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Beaux Collins was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return, requiring him to miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to an undisclosed injury.
Carter Runyon was placed on injured reserve by the Raiders with an undisclosed injury and is ineligible to return before Week 5 of the 2026 season.
Dontae Fleming was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Undisclosed
Undisclosed
Corey Kiner was traded to the Patriots and is listed as active, positioning him as a backup running back behind Rhamondre Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson (ankle).
Undisclosed
Arm
Dont'e Thornton Jr. was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four games of the 2025 regular season.
Ribs
Campbell suffered a significant leg injury in practice and has been placed on injured reserve, sidelining him for the 2026 regular season.
Trevor Etienne was placed on injured reserve with an ankle injury suffered in Friday's preseason game and will miss at least four games.
Tory Horton has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury for over a week, but head coach Mike Macdonald indicated it is not a long-term concern.
Robbie Ouzts has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Hampton was active in the preseason finale with limited snaps, recovering well from a fractured left ankle that limited him to nine games last season.
Dillon Gabriel was placed on injured reserve to start the 2026 season with a back injury that is not considered serious, requiring him to miss at least the first four games.
Bhayshul Tuten missed Wednesday practice due to illness but is expected to be healthy for Week 1 against the Browns in 11 days.
Tre Harris missed the final two preseason games with an undisclosed injury but is expected to be available for the regular-season opener.
TreVeyon Henderson is dealing with a right ankle injury, has not been cleared for full practice participation, and his status for Week 1 against the Seahawks remains uncertain.

Luther Burden III is recovering from a groin injury suffered in early August and is participating in practice this week, but his availability for the Week 1 opener against the Panthers remains uncertain.
Ferguson is dealing with soreness and working off to the side at practice, but remains available and is expected to compete for snaps as a potential third tight end option for the Rams.
Isaiah Bond has been listed as questionable for upcoming games.
Carson Towt has been placed on the Injured Reserve list.
Sarratt is healthy but faces significant roster competition and may struggle to make the 53-man roster as a fourth-round pick behind more productive options like Ja'Kobi Lane.
Adam Randall was placed on injured reserve by the Ravens with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least the first four games of the regular season, with his earliest return date being October 11.
Jaren Kanak has been placed on Injured Reserve.
Dominic Richardson was placed on the Jets' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement to have any chance of playing in 2026.
DJ Rogers, a tight end, suffered an MCL sprain during preseason and has been placed on the Cowboys' injured reserve list for the entire 2026 regular season.
Jeff Caldwell hyperextended his left knee during practice and was placed on injured reserve, expected to miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Knee
EJ Smith reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Chase Roberts was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches a settlement with the Raiders.
Undisclosed

Jeremiyah Love is dealing with a high-ankle sprain suffered in preseason Week 1 and was not suited up at Tuesday's practice, though he is progressing well and expected to be available for the Week 1 regular-season opener.
Jordyn Tyson was placed on injured reserve with a right hamstring injury expected to sideline him for approximately two months, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Kenyon Sadiq is on track to play Week 1 despite missing training camp and preseason with a hernia, but will have a limited role as he ramps up activity.
De'Zhaun Stribling is sidelined with a shoulder injury and will miss Thursday's preseason game against Las Vegas, but is expected to be ready for the Week 1 matchup against the Rams.
Oscar Delp is nursing a hamstring injury at Saints training camp with uncertain severity, though he has time to recover before the preseason finale.
Ted Hurst III is active and available but faces reduced playing time if Emeka Egbuka, Jalen McMillan, and Tez Johnson are healthy for Week 1.
Joe Royer was placed on the reserve/non-football illness list and must miss at least the first four weeks of the regular season due to a personal issue.
Kaytron Allen is expected to begin the regular season as the third-string running back but could see increased workload if injuries to Croskey-Merritt or White linger into Week 1.
Undisclosed
Carsen Ryan returned to action in Thursday's preseason game after leaving Tuesday's practice early with a foot injury, catching both targets for nine yards.
Haynes King suffered a hamstring injury in the Hall of Fame Game and will miss the final three preseason games, putting his roster spot in jeopardy.
Undisclosed
Hayden Large was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and must miss at least four regular-season games before becoming eligible to return.
Quentin Moore was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.

Undisclosed
Chase Curtis was placed on injured reserve after suffering a knee injury during a preseason game and will need to reach an injury settlement with the Jets for any chance to play in 2026.
Chip Trayanum was placed on injured reserve due to a neck injury suffered in the preseason finale and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season.

Matthew Caldwell was placed on injured reserve by the Rams with an undisclosed injury and will miss the upcoming season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Carnell Tate missed Tuesday's practice due to stiffness but is expected to be available for Week 1 with no indication his status is in danger.

Eli Stowers is dealing with a hamstring injury and may have limited gameday availability even after returning to health, with additional concerns about his depth chart position behind multiple veterans.
Kacmarek is considered week-to-week with an undisclosed injury and did not play in the preseason finale.
Bell was cleared to return to full practice and played in the preseason finale, but is still working on conditioning following ACL surgery rehabilitation.
Coleman returned from an undisclosed injury to play in Saturday's preseason game, catching 2 of 5 targets for 32 yards, but faces significant depth chart competition at wide receiver.
Brenen Thompson practiced in a non-contact jersey after being held out Saturday with an undisclosed injury, but his return to the field is a positive sign for availability.
Connor Hulstein was placed on the Jets' injured reserve list with an undisclosed injury and will need to reach an injury settlement to have any chance of playing in 2026.
